title: Black holes don’t suck things in like cosmic vacuum cleaners
body: From a distance, a black hole pulls just like any other object with the same mass. If the Sun were magically replaced by a black hole of equal mass, only about 6 km across, Earth would keep orbiting exactly as it does now; it would just get cold and dark. The danger is up close, near the event horizon, where gravity becomes so intense that nothing, not even light, can climb back out.
